review.full_review:
Reviewed the actual DUAL publication plan, canonical SHA-256 e057c3e6fb96751bab99b8657f21c3033be0cd3cb74356bc130075bb74decfb4, for publication purpose only and exactly DUAL-01, DUAL-02 and DUAL-03. Decision: approve the specified release procedure within that scope. This is a separate decision from the earlier finite CPU execution-plan review.

The current plan binds final source-freeze-v3, the original independently accepted implementation evidence, the separate final test-fixture delta, and the current independent result-validation artifact and rechecker. I rechecked the canonical document/advice dependencies and all84 final source hashes. I personally ran the final-v3 aggregate:783 tests,782 passed and one explicitly skipped real-tmux opt-in; Reader3 passed. The current scoped result rechecker again returns usable-with-scope. The native15-sample arithmetic and initial revise-to-approve review history remain frozen historical evidence, not a newly repeated model run or a claim of live deployment.

The architecture meets the intended separation without adding specialist managers: planner-main owns the plan/execution, while an independently authenticated review-main assesses the complete plan and returns full feedback plus approve/revise/reject. Tests exercised forged or shared identities, executable-field changes, adopted advice/evidence invalidation, preserved ordinary progress, permission separation, persistent bounded review cycles, legacy stripping, post-effect revocation/restart fencing and explicit reconciliation. Publication-only scope is fixed by trusted host configuration; unsuccessful scope changes cannot enroll unrelated requirements, and publication receipts cannot become execution permission. Existing15 specialist roles, canonical documents, independent data validation and permission boundaries are retained.

The release procedure appropriately leaves current authorization, exact candidate acceptance, latest-main integration, non-force publication and exact remote commit/tree readback to the trusted publishing controller. No push or deployment has been observed by this review, and DUAL-03 must remain pending until those checks finish. Any changed source, stable plan, guide, adopted advice, evidence or trusted publication scope requires the specified revalidation and a fresh bound receipt. The pending result-registry labels remain historical labels; current acceptance comes from the authenticated independent proof.

One nonblocking wording issue is recorded below: DUAL-01's descriptive method mentions the earlier16-document delta, whereas its exact current_source_freeze and acceptance fields already bind the separately verified final-v3 one-fixture correction. This approval uses the strict final-v3 hashes and current proof, with no extra change allowance. Do not alter approved plan bytes merely for this wording cleanup; clarify it if a later plan version is otherwise necessary.

Limits remain explicit: the real-tmux executable is absent and that integration was not run; recorded native reviews are replayed by the finite CPU script without model API calls; token and cost values are unknown. This review does not establish general correctness, production deployment, quality improvement, token savings or performance gains, and does not create publication permission.

verdict.summary: Approve this exact actual DUAL publication-only plan and current evidence; retain separate authorization, candidate checks and remote readback.

intent.reason: The actual release contains only the requested planner-main/review-main upgrade and its bounded validation. Exactly DUAL-01..03 are covered; no unrelated historical retention or completion nodes are added.

guide.reason: The full canonical task/document snapshot and adopted advice hashes validate. No human guide exists in this project and no guide writes are proposed. Current user and host permissions remain separate and authoritative.

assumptions.reason: The implementation binds the full actual DAG and trusted context identities, preserves full feedback, and rejects stale, forged or publication-purpose execution. CPU and recorded-review evidence are accurately distinguished from a continuously deployed model service.

prior_results.reason: Partial lexical searches and the unregistered independent-evidence-directory gap remain explicit. Unrelated historical corpus/integration hits do not supply acceptance. This release instead binds the exact independently checked old scope and separately fresh final-v3 regression/result proof.

acceptance.reason: The independent reviewer freshly ran final-v3 full783 with782 passes and one explicit real-tmux skip, Reader3 and the managed-worker suite, and rechecked all84 current source hashes. The current result contract revalidates as usable-with-scope; old results remain provenance only.

risk.reason: Publication-only purpose and exact trusted DUAL scope are required. Separate repository authorization, candidate acceptance, latest-main reconciliation, non-force publication and exact remote readback remain mandatory. No deployment, guide modification or unrelated requirement enrollment is authorized.

resources.reason: The publication review has a finite initially selected6-cycle/7200-second host budget. No new model service, GPU, credentials or paid compute is required. Token/cost usage remains unknown, and exhausted epochs require trusted authorized intervention.

findings.feedback: The descriptive phrase referring only to the16-document delta predates the final one-test-fixture correction, but exact done_when/current_source_freeze and publication_candidate fields correctly bind the final-v3 bytes and current proof.
findings.requested_change: Keep all current release checks keyed to the exact final-v3 hashes and current proof. Clarify this historical wording only if a later plan version is otherwise required; do not mutate this approved plan in place.
